title: 2.7 Pillars of Climate Resilient Green Economy of Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia’s CRGE strategy, its four pillars, renewable energy, forests and energy-efficient technology. Medium level.

questions.question: What approach does the CRGE strategy follow?
options: A sectoral approach
A random approach
A single-farm approach
An urban-only approach

questions.question: How does the agriculture pillar limit pressure on forests?
options: White tundra absorbs more sunlight than forests
By limiting expansion of land under cultivation
Continental crust is thinner than oceanic crust
It enables green development across the economy
questions.correctAnswer: By limiting expansion of land under cultivation

questions.question: Which forest measures does CRGE prioritize?
options: Together they confirm that the climate is changing
Offering a paradigm change from fixism to mobilism
Climate is measured over years; weather over a day
Afforestation, reforestation and forest management

questions.question: Why is electricity considered a fundamental enabler of development?
options: White tundra absorbs more sunlight than forests
Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans
By limiting expansion of land under cultivation
It powers cities, industry and irrigation pumps
questions.correctAnswer: It powers cities, industry and irrigation pumps

questions.question: Which industries are named in the technology pillar?
options: Only agriculture and mining
Only healthcare and education
It covered only the Southern Hemisphere
Cement, textile, leather and fertilizer

questions.question: Which transport measure appears in the fourth pillar?
options: Roughly 3.4 centimeters per decade
Ocean heat has no effect on storms
Stricter fuel efficiency standards
Removal of all railways

questions.question: How can clean energy benefit other sectors?
options: By limiting expansion of land under cultivation
It enables green development across the economy
It is the rigid shell broken into moving plates
It powers cities, industry and irrigation pumps
questions.correctAnswer: It enables green development across the economy

questions.question: What opportunity arises if clean power supply exceeds domestic demand?
options: Exporting electricity to neighboring countries
It will return exactly to preindustrial levels
Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
Reduced acid rain, haze and photochemical smog

questions.question: What does area closure contribute to?
options: Forests release all carbon immediately
Summer temperatures are never recorded
Increased storage of carbon in forests
Eccentricity, precession and obliquity
questions.correctAnswer: Increased storage of carbon in forests

questions.question: Which national plan does CRGE complement?
options: The sixth pillar of the homegrown economic reform
More frequent droughts and unpredictable rainfall
The plate pushes mountains upward without melting
A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
questions.correctAnswer: The sixth pillar of the homegrown economic reform
